request.query: cardinality of bounded natural Finsupp box filtered by arbitrary predicate counted by last coordinate fibers

items.name: Cardinal.mk_finsupp_nat
items.type: ∀ (α : Type u) [Nonempty α], Cardinal.mk (α →₀ ℕ) = max (Cardinal.mk α) Cardinal.aleph0

items.name: Nat.count_eq_card_filter_range
items.type: ∀ (p : ℕ → Prop) [inst : DecidablePred p] (n : ℕ), Nat.count p n = {x ∈ Finset.range n | p x}.card

items.name: Cardinal.mk_finsupp_of_fintype
items.type: ∀ (α β : Type u) [inst : Fintype α] [inst_1 : Zero β], Cardinal.mk (α →₀ β) = Cardinal.mk β ^ Fintype.card α

items.name: Nat.count_eq_card_fintype
items.type: ∀ (p : ℕ → Prop) [inst : DecidablePred p] (n : ℕ), Nat.count p n = Fintype.card { k // k < n ∧ p k }

items.name: Finsupp.filter
items.type: {α : Type u_1} → {M : Type u_5} → [inst : Zero M] → (p : α → Prop) → [DecidablePred p] → (α →₀ M) → α →₀ M
